faq.a: Snapchat's minimum age is 13. Teen accounts have stricter defaults: friends-only contact, no public profile, and limits on who can find them. Parents can use Family Center to see their teen's friends and who they message, without reading messages.

Memories are saved to your Snapchat account. Snap introduced storage limits with paid storage plans for very large Memories collections, so export anything important to your phone's gallery or another backup.

faq.q: Why is my Snapchat camera not working?
faq.a: Check that Snapchat has camera permission, close other apps using the camera, update Snapchat, and restart the phone. Clearing the cache in Snapchat's settings also helps.

faq.q: Can I use Snapchat on my laptop?
faq.a: Yes. Snapchat for Web at web.snapchat.com lets you chat and call from a computer browser.
